name: Penelles (Spain)
description: Red field charged with a yellow-sleeved arm with its elbow at the bottom, the hand holding a white sabre pointing towards the hoist.
history: The official flag of Penelles is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with the arm with its elbow below, dressed in yellow and with a yellow hand, holding the white sabre of the arms facing the hoist, the whole 19/24 of the height of the cloth; approved on 20 April 2006 and published in the DOGC on 24 May 2006.

features.role: arm dressed in yellow with its elbow downward
sabre held in the hand, facing the hoist
